input.quote: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: Section 12.4 binds only Customer, is a full no-hire ("hire, or employ"), covers every Vendor employee rather than only personnel involved in the Services, runs twenty-four months post-term, and expressly overrides any general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out ("regardless of how the employee applies"). That is walk-away territory under the rule and fails the fallback on every material term; it also conflicts with Section 12.3, which confirms Customer has made no no-hire commitment and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment. Consistent with the redline guidance, we narrowed the clause to the fallback: mutual, twelve months from the end of the individual's involvement, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and the no-hire deleted. Our preferred position remains no non-solicit on Customer at all.

proposal.summary: Narrow one-sided 24-month no-hire to a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a one-sided no-hire covering all Vendor employees for twenty-four months with no carve-out; our position is no non-solicit on Customer, and Section 12.3 already confirms we give no no-hire commitment. We have narrowed this to our fallback: a mutual twelve-month non-solicitation limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with the usual general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and the hiring restriction deleted.

ops.oldText: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
ops.newText: 12.4 During the term and for twelve months after the end of an individual's involvement in the Services, neither Party shall knowingly solicit for employment any personnel of the other Party who were directly involved in performing or receiving the Services. This Section does not restrict either Party from engaging or hiring any person who responds to a general advertisement or other recruitment activity not specifically targeted at the other Party's personnel, or who approaches that Party on an unsolicited basis, and neither Party is restricted from hiring or employing any such person.
